descriptionChirho: Substantivized Qal participle denoting a person who acts with hostility — an adversary, foe, or enemy — with various pronominal suffixes (my/your/his) and construct forms indicating possession or relationship.

Verbal action of causing distress or harassment, attested in finite forms (perfect, imperfect, conjunctive perfect), infinitive absolute, and predicatively-used participles emphasizing the ongoing activity of oppression rather than identifying a person.
